notes.title: Update.
notes.content: Fixed an issue with large units like titans not melee attacking, this issue could also occasionally cause the game to crash.

notes.title: Iron Within
notes.content:
Added 4 Scenarios to the Iron Within campaign.

Added a brand new mission called The Skull Catacombs in Skull Point.

notes.title: Brand New Underworld DLC
notes.content:
This update adds a brand new Underworld IAP which includes:

[list]

[*]9 New combat units
[/list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/638760/

notes.title: Fourth Patch
notes.content:
We have released an update today that fixes and issue where the game could become unresponsive when exiting a menu.

This latest build also provides access to our new DLC

http://store.steampowered.com/app/597270/

notes.title: Second Patch
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for the feedback. We have released a small update today which should fix the following issues:

Mission Balance:
Drop Zone (Campaign)
The Traitors’ Warren (Campaign)

Graphical:
Units with destroyed weapons will now show an icon indicating if some or all of their weapons have been destroyed.

General:
Turning buttons clickable area improved
Fix crash on End Turn in Communication Breakdown
Terminators now only have a 50% chance of losing health due to the toxic surface

Any feedback please let us know on the forum or by emailing support@hexwar.com

~The HexWar Team

notes.title: First Patch
notes.content:
Thank you everyone for the feedback.  We have released a small update today which should fix the following issues.

We are busy working on other fixes and features so keep an eye out for the next update!

Mission Balance Edits:
Bunker Infiltration

Graphical:
Doorways no longer appear over units

General:
Possible fix for music issue reported.
Blast weapons are more in-line with tabletop rules.
Fix problem where infantry drop-pods could be called from inside buildings.

UI:
Keyboard settings window scrolls fixed
Mouse settings window scroll alignment fixed

Any feedback please let us know on the forum or by emailing support@hexwar.com

~The HexWar Team
